ASEGURAMIENTO
To: [Name of Bank]
Subject: Asset Freeze for Laboratorios Quiroz, Delgado y Otero
Pursuant to Article 160 of the Fiscal Code and Article 142 of the Credit Institutions Law, we hereby instruct you to freeze all funds and accounts belonging to Laboratorios Quiroz, Delgado y Otero (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") with a value equal to or greater than Three Million Pesos (MXN 3,000,000.00).
Without prejudice to the aforementioned legal basis, we hereby notify you that this asset freeze shall be effective as of the date of this instruction and shall remain in effect until further notice from our office.
In accordance with Article 160, we request that you take immediate action to identify and freeze all accounts, deposits, and transactions related to the Company, including but not limited to checking, savings, and investment accounts, as well as any other type of account or instrument used for financial transactions.
Additionally, we require that you report back to our office with the following information: (1) a detailed list of all frozen accounts, including account numbers, names of beneficiaries, and amounts; (2) any outstanding transactions or debits made on said accounts prior to the effective date of this instruction; and (3) confirmation that all necessary measures have been taken to prevent any further withdrawals or transfers from said accounts.
Please note that we shall closely monitor compliance with these instructions and may request additional information or clarification at any time. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in legal consequences, as set forth by the aforementioned laws.
By signing below, you acknowledge receipt of this instruction and agree to carry out its provisions. Please return a signed copy of this document to our office within three business days from the date hereof.
Sincerely,
[Your Name] Junior Lawyer [Mexican Government Authority]
